column10: [E1D1] Formalises warm-up #9's 'a target inside the existing range needs no extension' and #21's A1-strict converse. Degenerate in the first ~300s of a phase (the extreme is the entry) — the reader's rule guards it with a phase-age term. Its practical importance is that it survives an fvol refusal, which COVERAGE and ladder_position do not. [E1D2] THE DAY-2 INDICTMENT. The term measures room INSIDE the phase range on the trade side, so an entry AT a fresh extreme has zero room by construction: it refuses every continuation/breakout entry and accepts only trades pointed back across the range. It is a MEAN-REVERSION prior wearing a capacity filter clothes. On an EXPANDED day (S2 day_type_so_far, 112.1% of range_hat) it appears in the refusal set of 24 of 38 winners; SI-20210702-051810-L (ext_needed $512.5) paid +$1,707.50 and SI-20210702-052297-L (ext $537.5) paid +$1,682.50.
